Production sketch debugger

Paste the complete Designer-produced sketch-design/v2 JSON, not a tool wrapper or Markdown fence. A single sketch/v2 document also works. Retained v1 documents and collections are read explicitly without conversion. Validation and rendering use the production modules.

This isolated tool does not publish a Design, call an API, or access a Copilot session. Editing never rewrites your JSON. Loading a sample explicitly replaces the editor.
